subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw support trusted external workspace agent-config discovery, or should multi-project agent onboarding stay on explicit `agents.list` / `agents.create` plus zero-restart mutation APIs?
rationale: The request adds a new config and discovery surface that can affect security boundaries, session-state ownership, and gateway runtime discovery policy, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product model.

options.title: Prefer explicit agent mutation
options.body: Keep central config as the source of truth and improve zero-restart `agents.create/update/delete` or CLI workflows instead of scanning external workspaces.

options.title: Design trusted discovery
options.body: Approve a bounded `agents.autoDiscover`-style design with trusted roots, precedence rules, config validation, security review, and upgrade/doctor behavior before implementation.

options.title: Reject runtime discovery
options.body: Close this direction later if maintainers decide external workspace config scanning should remain an external script or plugin workflow.

recommendation.title: Prefer explicit agent mutation
recommendation.body: Keep central config as the source of truth and improve zero-restart `agents.create/update/delete` or CLI workflows instead of scanning external workspaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config mutation and gateway agent-method history makes this the best available routing owner for the product/API decision.
